citations.claim: At first violating step 24 the body centre is at x~15.13 overlapping wall 0 by 0.37, after bouncing to vx~+43.6
One step before, body approaches from the right at ~51.8 m/s, 0.57 from wall surface

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.02206 to 0.0005 only; same 24 steps, same bodies/walls. Small-dt run has no violation, showing failure is integration/collision-resolution dependent, not initial overlap.

explanation: High-speed (~52 m/s) body strikes the right face of a thin wall with large dt=0.022. Impulse reverses vx (-46.4 to +43.6) but positional correction leaves the circle overlapping the wall by 0.37 > 0.15 limit at step 24. Tiny-dt rerun resolves the same impact cleanly, indicating substep/positional-correction insufficient at large per-step displacement.
vision_note: The red circle moves leftward toward the gray wall across steps 21 to 23, closing the gap each frame. At step 24 it ends up embedded in and overlapping the wall's right edge instead of bouncing off cleanly.
